title: HiItsMatt.dev
tagline: This site: a portfolio built as a stack of full-screen pages
summary: My portfolio. Four full-screen pages that hand over to each other rather than scroll: a shader hero whose gradient ends on a chevron punched out of the ink above it, a live GitHub overview, a career page that draws my work history from weekly commit counts and deals each employer's products as a hand of cards, and a case study page per project carrying its own media, write-up and metadata. A Hono API behind it holds the credentials and the caches, reading the live half of the site from GitHub, the curated half from a `.portfolio` folder committed inside each project's own repository, and the career half from a private data bucket, so private work can be shown without handing a token to the browser. It runs on one CloudFront distribution with two origins — a private S3 bucket and the same Hono app on Lambda — so the browser only ever sees one hostname.
